body:
Partial M1-01 client safety checkpoint from accepted M0 head 6aa01995f6dcb94fd28d358badc9f8d1e0273d39. Adopts the adult18 semantic receipt policy, fences delayed non-health private reads at account boundaries, propagates Shelf read failures, and closes health authority when age eligibility closes. Installs the explicitly issued M1 governance profile while preserving historical M0 inputs and controls.

This draft exists to inspect the cumulative stage and run unchanged CI. M1-01 remains incomplete: data-rights exits during re-verification, the complete integrated race/recovery audit and manual Shelf surface matrix remain open. Source/native/provider/review/release evidence axes remain separate. Main promotion, merge and release are not authorized. PR8 stays unmerged. Exact measurements and handoff are under docs/brain/checkpoints/M1-01/ and ONSKIN_BRAIN_HANDOFF.txt.
